results.title: CAPTURED
results.overview: Andy, a stressed and obsessive wildlife photographer desperate for a competition-winning shot, sets out alone into the woods where his anxiety, lack of medication, and mounting frustration blur the line between ambition and self-destruction.

results.title: Believers
results.overview: A ragtag amateur cricket team from the UK tours The Gambia to face a national side far beyond their level. As losses mount and bonds deepen, they discover what the game truly means to them.

results.title: Accursed
results.overview: When a nun’s cursed secret resurfaces on Emma’s 21st birthday, a lake-house reunion turns deadly. A masked cult and dark prophecy force Emma and her friends to face possession, betrayal, and a midnight ritual that could raise ancient evil.

results.title: The Little Mammoth
results.overview: Fluffy the baby mammoth awakens after a thousand-year slumber in the icy desert and sets out to find his mother. They say she can be found in distant and mysterious Africa. But Africa is far away, and getting there is extremely difficult, and the baby mammoth's only companion is a chick named Tupik, who dreams of performing his rap at the "Africa's Got Talent" competition. Together, they must overcome numerous challenges: crossing the ocean on an ice floe, escaping from bloodthirsty crocodiles, defeating treacherous hyenas, performing their music in front of a wide variety of audiences, and, most importantly, learning to be friends and understanding that friendship means responsibility and support.

results.title: Downtown
results.overview: In 1988, three young gay men, Ronnie, Lennart and Bas, throw themselves into Amsterdam's nightlife  scene. It’s a life full of friendship, sex and drugs. Until the mysterious AIDS virus casts a shadow over their  lives and one of them disappears after becoming infected. Thirty-two years later, in the middle of the 2021  lockdown, Ronnie recognises the missing Bas in the subway. An evening unfolds that none of them had  expected to see, but which had been in the air for years. The AIDS epidemic has had a major impact on all  three of their lives. Where they lost each other 32 years ago, they hope to find each other again.

results.title: Multiple Choice
results.overview: A group of students are killed off one by one after writing a multiple choice exam. One of them is the killer...

results.title: Crown or Class
results.overview: Crown or Class is a Pan-African feature documentary that follows two young African women; one in Belgium, the other in Ghana — whose journeys into natural hair care unfold into a powerful exploration of identity, beauty, and belonging. What begins as a personal choice becomes a wider reflection on how Eurocentric beauty standards continue to shape African women’s self-worth across continents

results.title: Skin and Pavement
results.overview: An insecure aspiring athlete pushes himself to the limit and faces the consequences.

results.title: The City of the Living
results.overview: Luca is twenty-three years old. He lives with an adoptive family who loves him. He moves between the suburbs and the city center with his friends and has a girlfriend with whom he shares a love that is young, yet significant for them both. Luca is searching for his path at an age when everything still feels possible and, at the same time, already lost; in this pursuit, he leads a double life. One night, after a seemingly chance encounter, the trajectory of Luca’s life is shattered, colliding with blind and senseless violence.

results.title: Lottie Dottie Chicken: The Movie
results.overview: When a clumsy stork mixed up the eggs during delivery, Lottie Dottie Chicken's first egg ends up in the nest of a fearsome hawk in the mountains.

results.title: Red Egg of the Crimson King
results.original_title: Red Egg of the Crimson King
results.overview: In a dilapidated apartment drowned in the oppressive hum of electricity, a man kills his evenings by watching, through a hole in the wall, an empty stage bathed in childish music. This strange routine brings him a fragile joy.  But one evening, something appears: an egg-shaped object marked with a face. An enigmatic presence. An angel… God?

results.title: First Day, Last Year
results.overview: Jun and Aira spend the first hours of the new year together. A year passes. Photographs, journal entries, and an empty street remain from their encounter.

results.title: Djamin Setia Selamanya
results.overview: Educated under colonial rule, a determined young man from Tanah Karo enlists in a paramilitary unit under the false promise of liberation, ultimately rising to become a pivotal military strategist in North Sumatra's guerrilla defense while balancing acute domestic sacrifices with absolute duty to the nascent Indonesian Republic.

results.title: Heart of Light: Eleven Songs for Fiji
results.original_title: Heart of Light: Eleven Songs for Fiji
results.overview: After decades abroad, Iona returns to her childhood home on Fiji, sensing that there she might find the answers to many questions she has about civilisation and its discontent.

results.title: Betty Balloon
results.overview: Betty Balloon tells the story of a modern family - who just happen to be balloons. Mom Balloon is an inventor, Dad Balloon runs the home, Bobby Balloon is a super tweenie, and the heart of it all is Betty Balloon, a creative and imaginative four-year-old. Life turns upside down when a cactus family moves in next door. Mom Cactus, Dad Cactus, tweenie sister Karla Cactus and four-year-old Kaj Cactus. The Balloon family must learn to connect with their new neighbours, but it is the children who take the first step when Betty Balloon becomes best friends with Kaj Cactus. In the Betty Balloon universe, it is the kids who teach the adults how to open and stay curious.

results.title: Renegade Immortal: Battle of the Immortal Slayer
results.overview: Trapped in a fatal pursuit within the Celestial Realm of Thunder, Wang Lin faces his ultimate crisis. Watch the underdog defy the odds, flip the script in a world-shaking counterattack, and achieve the ultimate, magnificent feat: SLAYING A CELESTIAL.

results.title: Robbin' the Hood
results.overview: Two brothers are roped into a scheme to rob from the rich and give to the poor, only to find their victims are not who they think they are.

results.title: Without Looking Back
results.overview: A story about friendship and a crime that never happened. The main characters are Sonya and Zhenya. One day, they push a guy who was bothering them to the ground and, thinking they've killed him, go on the run.
